== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Blacksword is a powerful combatant who utilizes a large, two-handed blade that appears bright red rather than black. He is accompanied by a [[Blood Shadow]], which enhances his attacks by providing extra reach and force through lashes of energy. During combat, he demonstrates high maneuverability by using specialized footwear that creates ripples of light beneath his feet, allowing him to run through the air. His fighting style involves combining [[Striker techniques]] with beams of energy and projectiles of jagged [[Forged madra]]. In a significant confrontation, he exerted extreme strain on his [[spirit]] and soul to prepare a final volley of attacks before disappearing in a flash of [[white light]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Blacksword is a chosen of [[Reigan Shen]]. Additionally, [[Dross]] possesses a predictive model for him.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A member of [[Redmoon Hall]], Blacksword engages in combat wielding a massive, two-handed blade of bright red. He keeps his weapon sheathed within his [[Blood Shadow]] and utilizes a [[Striker technique]] during his matches. While fighting, he is able to run through the air by creating ripples of light beneath his feet. Despite these abilities, he faces challenges such as running low on [[madra]] and being countered by [[Dross]]'s predictive model.}}
